about_the_game:
The Continent Falls, the Demon Horde Invades, the World on the Brink of Destruction.

The final hope of all races rests on the great city of Belrak. As the most valiant warrior within its walls, it is your time to unite the races, defend the gates, and hold the last three lines of defense!

Game Features:​​

  • ​​Beyond Traditional Tower Defense​​
    Command your hero to synergize with defensive towers—cover each other, repel enemies, or even ​​launch yourself into battle​​ using a tower’s power! Absorb tower energy to empower your hero and unleash chaos!

  • ​​Roguelike-Style Progression​​
    Build your strategy dynamically with endless upgrades. Strengthen your hero to dominate the battlefield or deploy followers (towers) with precision to rain fire on the hordes. Every run is a fresh challenge!

  • ​​Diverse Heroic Playstyles​​
    Choose from heroes with wildly distinct combat styles: berserk attackers, relentless assassins, spellcasting mages, tower-defending guardians, and more. Experiment with unique builds and synergies!

  • ​​Followers & Ultimate Transformations​​
    Command ​​dozens of followers​​ (defensive towers), each with multiple upgrade paths. Use mystic relics to ​​evolve them into ultimate forms​​, adapting your arsenal to crush ever-growing threats!

  • ​​Unbreakable Gates​​
    The city’s towering gates grant time to regroup—hero or follower deaths won’t end the battle. But remember: ​​if the gates fall, all is lost!​

    ​

  • ​​Bosses & Relics of Power​​
    Face apocalyptic demonic bosses every 5 minutes. Defeat them to claim their ​​game-changing relics​​—but tread carefully, for risk and reward go hand in hand!

  • ​​Persistent Growth​​
    Even defeat fuels your rise! Earn experience to unlock new content, fortify defenses, and grow stronger between battles. Every fight brings you closer to victory!

name: Gate Warfare

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows7,Windows10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Graphics: 1Gb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: "Gate Warfare" is a medieval fantasy roguelike tower defense game where players take on the role of a kingdom's hero. Fend off endless waves of demonic hordes, recruit companions, upgrade your skills, and defend the last bastion of hope—the great city of Belrak.
